map.将核子束缚成核所释放的能量。: The energy released when nucleons are bound into a nucleus.
map.结合能 BE = Δm × c²；质量亏损 Δm =（Z × m_质子 + N: Binding energy BE = Δm x c²; the mass defect Δm = (Z x m_proton + N x m_neutron) - m_nucleus, where Z is the proton number, N the neutron number and A = Z + N. Since tables usually give atomic masses, the hydrogen atom mass replaces the proton mass in practice, i.e. Δm = Z x m_H + N x m_neutron - m_atom. With 1 u = 931.494 MeV/c², BE(MeV) = Δm(u) x 931.494; a larger binding energy means the nucleons are bound more tightly.
